templates.description: Office account with every permission except the owner-only ones (company settings, audit log, subscription): all projects, no approval limits, every amount visible.
Office user: projects, team on site, purchases, rates and approvals of assigned projects. No billing or profit (add them per user).

Office accounts: billing, owner and supplier payments, cash, receivables and reports across all projects. No project or site changes.
Material: purchases at the store and sites, receiving, dispatch, stock counts and usage of assigned projects. No rates.
